pullRequests.title: Remove deprecated downlevelIteration option
pullRequests.body: This option is deprecated in TypeScript 6.0. It doesn't do anything when target is es2018, so can be safely removed from this config file.
pullRequests.author: RyanCavanaugh

rationale.impact: Single-file configuration cleanup removing one deprecated TypeScript option with no functional effect for the current ES2018 target. This is a very small maintenance change in the typo/config-cleanup band.
rationale.aiLeverage: No AI signals: no co-authored-by AI trailers, no AI tag in title, no AI-attributed body text, no known AI bot author, and 0/1 commits with AI trailers. The tiny one-line diff also looks handcrafted, so this falls in the 0-25 band.
rationale.quality: Clear, focused PR with a concise explanation of why the option can be removed: it is deprecated in TypeScript 6.0 and has no effect for the configured target. No tests are needed for this config-only deletion, but the scope is very small rather than exemplary.

insights.body: Improve PR descriptions for small bug fixes: #4223 and #4212 lost quality points due to missing or thin explanations. Require a short template covering root cause, fix summary, and validation/test evidence.

Most merged work is low-to-moderate impact, with 4 of 5 PRs scoring impact ≤34. Consider batching tiny config/dependency updates and prioritizing more core behavior fixes like #4212 when planning reviewer time.

AI-authored work appears useful but narrow: Copilot PR #4213 had high AI leverage and acceptable quality, yet only small impact. Use AI agents for scoped SSR/client safety fixes and dependency/config chores, with human review focused on tests and edge cases.
